# @dxtmisha/media

> Media resources, vector icon libraries, and geographical datasets for DXT UI — country flags, file types, social networks, and ISO 3166-1 country metadata.

Framework-agnostic, tree-shakeable, zero-dependency library providing vector SVG assets (flags, files, social media) and structured metadata registries with object-oriented helpers for file handling, profile URLs, and localized geography.

## Key Classes & Modules

- [MediaFile](src/classes/MediaFile.ts): OOP abstraction for resolving file names, extensions, category checkers (`isImage`, `isDocument`, `isArchive`, `isVideo`, `isAudio`, `isCode`, `isTable`, `isPresentation`), and SVG icons.
- [MediaFiles](src/classes/MediaFiles.ts): Static utility class for file path validation and metadata lookups (`get`, `getByCategory`, `getNeutral`, `getList`, `isLink`).
- [MediaFileIcon](src/classes/MediaFileIcon.ts): Registry class for managing and applying standard and custom SVG file icons (`add`, `addList`, `get`, `has`, `toItem`).
- [MediaSocial](src/classes/MediaSocial.ts): Manager for 35+ social networks with canonical profile URL generation (`getUrl`), handle extraction (`getValue`), and custom icon registries (`addIcon`, `addIcons`).
- [fileList](src/media/fileList.ts): Pure metadata registry of 85+ file types, extensions, and categories without embedded SVG icons.
- [socialList](src/media/socialList.ts): Catalog of 35 social media platforms with input masks, validation rules, and URL prefixes/suffixes.
- [geo](src/media/geo.json): Comprehensive ISO 3166-1 geographical dataset (phone codes, phone masks, timezones, primary languages, first weekday, non-metric unit overrides).

## Dedicated Subpath Exports & Asset Modules

- [library.ts](src/library.ts) (`@dxtmisha/media`): Core barrel exporting classes, metadata registries, and TypeScript types without bundled SVG assets.
- [flags](src/flags.ts) (`@dxtmisha/media/flags`): 250+ vector SVG country flags in PascalCase (`UsSvg`, `FrSvg`, `DeSvg`, `VnSvg`, `RuSvg`, etc.).
- [files](src/files.ts) (`@dxtmisha/media/files`): 85 vector SVG file icons (`fileIcons`) and `registerFileIcons()` initialization helper.
- [socials](src/socials.ts) (`@dxtmisha/media/socials`): 35 vector SVG social network icons (`socialIcons`) and `registerSocialIcons()` initialization helper.
